title: @platform/auth access primitives (tokens, active tier, tier guard, resource role)
allowedImports: import type { SubscriptionTier } from './index.js';   // already exported there: 'free' | 'tier_49' | 'tier_499'
Web Crypto only via the global `crypto` (crypto.subtle, crypto.getRandomValues). NO node:* imports. NO npm packages.
spec:
Create `access.ts` exporting EXACTLY these (named exports, ESM, strict TypeScript):

1. `export async function hashToken(input: string): Promise<string>` — SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of `input` using `crypto.subtle.digest`, returned as 64-char lowercase hex.

2. `export function generateToken(byteLength = 16): string` — throws `RangeError` if `byteLength < 16` (or not an integer). Fills `byteLength` random bytes with `crypto.getRandomValues` and encodes them as RFC 4648 base32 using the lowercase alphabet `abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz234567`, WITHOUT padding. 16 bytes => 26 chars, 32 bytes => 52 chars. (Encode by streaming bits: accumulate 8 bits per byte, emit a char for every 5 bits, and emit a final char for any leftover bits left-shifted into 5 bits.)

3. `export interface TierGrant { tier: 'tier_49' | 'tier_499'; startsAt: string; expiresAt: string }` (ISO-8601 strings).

4. `export function activeTier(grants: readonly TierGrant[], now: Date): SubscriptionTier` — a grant is active iff `startsAt <= now < expiresAt` (so `expiresAt === now` is EXPIRED, `startsAt === now` is ACTIVE). Parse with `Date.parse`; if either date is NaN the grant is ignored (fail closed). Return the highest active tier by rank free(0) < tier_49(1) < tier_499(2); return 'free' when none are active. Never mutate the input array.

5. `export class AuthError extends Error { readonly status: 401 | 403; readonly code: 'UNAUTHENTICATED' | 'UPGRADE_REQUIRED'; constructor(status: 401 | 403, code: 'UNAUTHENTICATED' | 'UPGRADE_REQUIRED', message?: string) }` — set `this.name = 'AuthError'`. Must work with `instanceof AuthError` (call `Object.setPrototypeOf(this, AuthError.prototype)`).

6. `export function requireTier(session: { userId: string; tier: SubscriptionTier } | null, required: SubscriptionTier): void` — `null` session => throw `new AuthError(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED')`. If rank(session.tier) < rank(required) => throw `new AuthError(403, 'UPGRADE_REQUIRED')`. Otherwise return normally. (A 'free' requirement with a free session passes.)

7. `export function resolveResourceRole(session: { userId: string } | null, ownerUserId: string): 'owner' | 'participant'` — 'owner' ONLY when `session` is non-null, `session.userId` is a non-empty string, and `session.userId === ownerUserId` (strict, case-sensitive). Everything else is 'participant'.

No default export. No other exports. No side effects at import time. Do not touch or re-export anything from index.ts.
